remarks: Beautifully renovated home provides endless possibilities for large or growing family located in the coveted Newfield neighborhood featuring 4,400 sq ft of finished space with 8+ bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, 10' ceilings, wood burning fireplace, and luxury finishes at every turn. Enjoy the open/versatile floorplan featuring a brand new kitchen with shaker style cabinets, quartz countertops and stainless steel appliances that opens up your large sun-filled dining and living room overlooking the private deck and fully fenced in backyard perfect for Grilling/entertaining. Recess lights, hardwood floors and tons of storage throughout. The Large primary bedroom with Spa like bathroom and four additional bedrooms complete the 2nd Floor. Head Upstairs to a fully finished 3rd floor featuring two additional bedrooms, full bathroom, kitchen area and huge play room.  Additional features included new HVAC , new windows, roof, Tankless hydro boilers, bathrooms, simply too many items to list. Walking distance to Restaurants, shops, parks, and places of worship.
